## QC, stress check and validation of ordinations {.unlisted}

```{r extract.nmds.checkfit-function, include=F}
extract.nmds.checkfit <- function(ord.object, ...) {
  
  checkfit_vals <- nmds.checkfit(ord.object)
  
  input.name.tooooo.long <- print(as.character(name)) 
  input.name.shorter <- sapply(strsplit(input.name.tooooo.long, ".k"), "[", 1) 
  
  out.df <- data.frame(name_of_row = paste0("k_", ord.object$ndim),
                       k_values = ord.object$ndim,
                       input_data = input.name.shorter,
                       stress = checkfit_vals$stress,
                       nonmetric.fit.r2 = checkfit_vals$nonmetric.fit.r2,
                       linear.fit.r2 = checkfit_vals$linear.fit.r2)
  
  class(out.df) <- "nmsd.gof"
  
  out.df
}
```

```{r make checkfit df, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, eval=F}
ord_checkfit_df = data.frame()

for (name in comm.ord.names.by.grass) {
  
  output = extract.nmds.checkfit(get(name))

  ord_checkfit_df = rbind(ord_checkfit_df, output)

}

```

```{r choose k vals, eval=F}
# Ideal stress value is < 0.05 (but k > 5 makes interpretation difficult)
    # Higher than 0.2 is poor (risks for false interpretation).
    # 0.1 - 0.2 is fair (some distances can be misleading for interpretation).
    # 0.05 - 0.1 is good (can be confident in inferences from plot).
    # Less than 0.05 is excellent (this can be rare).


ord_checkfit_df$stress<-round(ord_checkfit_df$stress,3)
ord_checkfit_df$nonmetric.fit.r2<-round(ord_checkfit_df$nonmetric.fit.r2,3)
ord_checkfit_df$linear.fit.r2<-round(ord_checkfit_df$linear.fit.r2,3)


# Final choices on k values

## AllG
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[1])
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[2])
  
  # flipping x axis coords for ease of interpretation
    # Fun.AllG.k5.ord$points[,1]<-Fun.AllG.k5.ord$points[,1]*-1 # already done
  
  saveRDS(Bac.AllG.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac.AllG.k5.ord.rds")
  saveRDS(Fun.AllG.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun.AllG.k5.ord.rds")

## ANGE
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[3])
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[4])
  
  #flip x coord of ITS Fun.ANGE.k5.ord
     # Fun.ANGE.k5.ord$points[,1]<-Fun.ANGE.k5.ord$points[,1]*-1 # already done
  
  saveRDS(Bac.ANGE.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac.ANGE.k5.ord.rds")
  saveRDS(Fun.ANGE.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun.ANGE.k5.ord.rds")

## BOER
  saveRDS(Bac.BOER.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac.BOER.k5.ord.rds")
  saveRDS(Fun.BOER.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun.BOER.k5.ord.rds")

## BOGR
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[7])
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[8])
  
  saveRDS(Bac.BOGR.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac.BOGR.k5.ord.rds")
  saveRDS(Fun.BOGR.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun.BOGR.k5.ord.rds")

## BUDA
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[9])
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[10])
  
  # flipping y axis coords for ease of interpretation
    # Fun.BUDA.k6.ord$points[,2]<-Fun.BUDA.k6.ord$points[,2]*-1 # already done
  
  saveRDS(Bac.BUDA.k6.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac.BUDA.k6.ord.rds")
  saveRDS(Fun.BUDA.k6.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun.BUDA.k6.ord.rds")

## SCSC
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[11])
  subset(ord_checkfit_df,ord_checkfit_df$input_data==comm.names.by.grass[12])
  
  saveRDS(Bac.SCSC.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac.SCSC.k5.ord.rds")
  saveRDS(Fun.SCSC.k5.ord, file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun.SCSC.k5.ord.rds")

```

## adonis2 tables {.unlisted .unnumbered .hidden}

### by grass {.unlisted .unnumbered .hidden}

```{r, eval=F, include=F}
# create container array (dim = c(nrow, ncol, n_df))
adonis.out_predGrass.list = vector("list", length = length(comm.names.by.grass[1:2]))

for (comm in comm.names.by.grass[1:2]) {
  adonis.temp_predGrass <- adonis2(phyloseq::distance(get(comm), method="bray") ~ Grass, 
          data = (as(sample_data(get(comm)), "data.frame")))
  
  adonis.temp_predGrass$comm <- comm 
  
  adonis.out_predGrass.list[[comm]] <- (as.data.frame(adonis.temp_predGrass))

  }

adonis.out.array_predGrass = do.call(rbind, adonis.out_predGrass.list)
```

\

### by Bin {.unlisted .unnumbered .hidden}

```{r, eval=F, include=F}
# create container array (dim = c(nrow, ncol, n_df))
adonis.out_predBin.list = vector("list", length = length(comm.names.by.grass))

for (comm in comm.names.by.grass) {
  adonis.temp_predBin <- adonis2(phyloseq::distance(get(comm), method="bray") ~ Bin, 
          data = (as(sample_data(get(comm)), "data.frame")))
  
  adonis.temp_predBin$comm <- comm 
  
  adonis.out_predBin.list[[comm]] <- (as.data.frame(adonis.temp_predBin))

  }

adonis.out.array_predBin = do.call(rbind, adonis.out_predBin.list)
```

### by Gradient {.unlisted .unnumbered .hidden}

```{r, eval=F, include=F}
# create container array (dim = c(nrow, ncol, n_df))
adonis.out_predGradient.list = vector("list", length = length(comm.names.by.grass))

# excluding BOER bc it only occurs in West

for (comm in comm.names.by.grass[c(1:4,7:12)]) {
  adonis.temp_predGradient <- adonis2(phyloseq::distance(get(comm), method="bray") ~ Gradient, 
          data = (as(sample_data(get(comm)), "data.frame")))
  
  adonis.temp_predGradient$comm <- comm 
  
  adonis.out_predGradient.list[[comm]] <- (as.data.frame(adonis.temp_predGradient))

  }

adonis.out.array_predGradient = do.call(rbind, adonis.out_predGradient.list)
```

saveRDS(adonis.out.array_predBin, file = '../processed_data/adonis2/adonis.out.array_predBin.rds')

## Generate plots for later viewing {.unlisted .unnumbered .hidden}

### color by grass {.unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r plot nmds AllG col Grass, include=F, eval=F}
nmds.Bac.AllG.colGrass_wleg<-plot_ordination(Bac.AllG, Bac.AllG.k5.ord, color = "Grass") +
  scale_color_manual(values = bac_grass_cols,
                     name="Grass Host") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9)+
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.9) +
  ggtitle("NMDS by Grass Host (90% confidence level for multivariate t-distribution)", subtitle = "16S") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_blank()
    ,panel.grid.major = element_blank()
    ,panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ,panel.background = element_blank()
    ,axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    legend.position="bottom",
    axis.title.x = element_text(color="black", size=14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color="black", size=14),
    legend.title  = element_text(color="black", size=14),
    legend.text  = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=.75)
  )

leg_nmds.colGrass<-get_legend(nmds.Bac.AllG.colGrass_wleg)
nmds.Bac.AllG.colGrass<-nmds.Bac.AllG.colGrass_wleg+theme(legend.position="none")

nmds.Fun.AllG.colGrass<-plot_ordination(Fun.AllG, Fun.AllG.k5.ord, color = "Grass") +
  scale_color_manual(values = fun_grass_cols,
                     name="Grass Host") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.9) +
  labs(y="") +
  ggtitle("", subtitle = "ITS") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_blank()
    ,panel.grid.major = element_blank()
    ,panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ,panel.background = element_blank()
    ,axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    legend.position="none",
    axis.title.x = element_text(color="black", size=14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color="black", size=14),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=.75)
  )

nmds.AllG.colGrass_upper<-plot_grid(nmds.Bac.AllG.colGrass,nmds.Fun.AllG.colGrass, ncol=2)
plot_grid(nmds.AllG.colGrass_upper,leg_nmds.colGrass, nrow=2, rel_heights = c(0.85,0.15))

ggsave(filename = "../analyses/ordinations/NMDS_AllG_colorGrass.png", plot = last_plot(), 
       device = "png", height = 4, width = 7, units = "in")
```

# Map

```{r}
# installed YARN in bash
# % curl -o- -L https://yarnpkg.com/install.sh | bash
# > We've added the following to your /Users/L347123/.zshrc
# > If this isn't the profile of your current shell then please add the following to your correct profile:

# export PATH="$HOME/.yarn/bin:$HOME/.config/yarn/global/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"

# > Successfully installed Yarn 1.22.19! Please open another terminal where the `yarn` command will now be available.

# # install dependencies
# yarn
# 
# # compile
# yarn build
# 
# # watch
# yarn watch
Sys.setenv('http_proxy'='http://proxyout.lanl.gov:8080')
Sys.setenv('HTTP_PROXY'='http://proxyout.lanl.gov:8080')
Sys.setenv('HTTPS_PROXY'='http://proxyout.lanl.gov:8080')



if (!require('devtools')) install.packages('devtools')
devtools::install_github('rstudio/leaflet')
library(leaflet)

# create df with only 1 rep/unique entry from each site
sd_Fun_m.std <- sample_data(Fun_m.std)
unique_sites <- unique(sd_Fun_m.std$Site)
first_entries <- sapply(unique_sites, function(site) which(sd_Fun_m.std$Site == site)[1])
Fun_meta_for_map <- sd_Fun_m.std[first_entries, ]

# Extract GPS coordinates and other metadata from sample data
# coords <- sample_data(Fun_m.std)[, c("Latitude", "Longitude", "Site", "Other_Metadata")]
coords <- sd_Fun_m.std
  
# Define colors based on other metadata (change this according to your metadata)
colors <- colorFactor(palette = c("#6BE9FF","#6ABEF9","#FFFA6C","#FFC25B"), domain = coords$Bin)
fun_bin_cols_n5<-c("North" = "#6BE9FF",
                    "North Central" = "#6ABEF9",
                    "South Central" = "#FFFA6C",
                    "South" = "#FFC25B")

# Create a leaflet map
m <- leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%  # Add a tile layer
  setView(lng = mean(coords$Longitude), lat = mean(coords$Latitude), zoom = 10)  # Set initial view based on the mean coordinates

# Add markers for each site
for (i in unique(coords$Site)) {
  site_coords <- coords[coords$Site == i, c("Latitude", "Longitude")]
  site_metadata <- coords[coords$Site == i, "Bin"]
  
  m <- addCircleMarkers(
    map = m,
    lng = site_coords$Longitude,
    lat = site_coords$Latitude,
    color = ~colors(site_metadata),  # Color markers based on other metadata
    popup = i  # Popup label for each marker
  )
}

# Print the map
m
pal <- colorFactor(c("navy", "red"), domain = c("ship", "pirate"))


colors_bin <- colorFactor(palette = c("#6BE9FF","#6ABEF9","#FFC25B","#FFFA6C"), domain = c("North", "North Central", "South", "South Central"))
leaflet(data = Fun_meta_for_map) %>% addTiles() %>% setView(-106.25329	, 37.62755, zoom = 5) %>% 
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude, popup = ~as.character(Site),color = ~colors_bin(Bin),fillOpacity = 0.9,radius = 15)
```
